weather_report:
Late morning settles over City Beach beneath a broad, uniform ceiling of cloud, the light diffused and calm, shadows erased. The sun will be shy today; through this steady overcast its bite is muted, though not absent, so a touch of sunscreen still makes sense if you linger outdoors. Visibility feels soft rather than sharp, a gray-blue clarity that flattens the sea and quiets the streets. Expect this subdued mood to hold into the afternoon, a day that favors unhurried errands and small comforts over spectacle.

Dress for mild uncertainty: light layers, long sleeves or a thin cardigan, and shoes suited to wandering. A cap or compact umbrella isn’t a bad pocket companion, more for peace of mind than necessity. It’s a good day to walk the promenade and watch the muted water, to slip into a bookstore or the library, to sort a few practical tasks, to brew something warm when you return. If you head out around lunch, the air will still be gentle and the UV kept in check by the cloud, good for an easy loop to the grocer or a quiet bench with a notebook.
